name: Seimei Shrine
scope: The 1905 Seimei Shrine main sanctuary and the attached worship frontage in the western precinct, including the front gabled canopy and adjoining low wings.
era: The present sanctuary built in 1905, with the exterior shown in Qualla’s December 2007 photographs.

stories.title: Seimei Shrine: Kyoto's Portal to the Spirit World

originalReview.notes: Main hall view identifies the stone front stair, black-brown carpentry, high rear roof, undulated front gable and lighter side eaves. Derive the exterior architecture and omit copyrighted signage or artwork.
The approach from the east torii shows the central arch roof and horizontal lower wings beyond it. Use the reference for the sanctuary enclosure only.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The two published Qualla architectural views match exact public-domain photos uploaded by their creator Fg2. The architecture is the only subject of the image evidence.
